title: The Thunderwind Pairing Manual
summary: A manual for students who hold both wind and lightning and who learn to charge the gale until it strikes as one force.

title: Manual of Fanned Flame
summary: A manual for students who hold both wind and fire and who learn to feed the flame with the gale and shape the gale with the flame.

title: Canon of the Stormcore
summary: A canon for core-formed students who hold wind and lightning and who bind both in the core to loose a single thunderous gale.

title: The Core Fanned Flame Canon
summary: A canon for core-formed students who hold wind and fire and who roar the core's flame through the core's gale in a single blaze.
